# NIM RUSH

NIM RUSH is a daily downhill skill-racing Mini App built for Nimiq. Each run
asks the rider to read the ridge, manage speed, choose a racing line, and
recover from mistakes before the finish.

## How it works

- Steer left and right across the course.
- Brake before corners and rough approaches.
- Drift through controlled turns, boost on clean exits, and tuck on straights.
- Use jumps and landings to build airtime without losing control.
- Complete three physical mission contracts: line, control, and risk.
- Review a transparent result: time, line, control, airtime, missions, drift,
  collisions, and missed gates.

Practice is available without a wallet. Ranked participation uses equal fixed
loadouts and server-side replay verification. A browser-submitted score is not
accepted as proof by itself.

Play: https://sface.site/
Source: https://github.com/Iziedking/sFace
Nimiq Mini Apps: https://nimiq.dev/mini-apps/
